title: Unit Event — Little Bravers!

meta.Outline: Leo/need continues to get their name out there as more people begin watching their videos and coming to see their shows. Then, someone from a record company appears before them and suggests that they put on their very own solo show...!

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hnng... Just one more...!
Just one more view until we reach 500!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Argh!
You're so close! Why is it taking so long?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, clinging to your phone like that isn't gonna help us get more views...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You too, Rin.
There's no real point in you two having a staring contest with her phone.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin
rows.Line: But!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand how you two feel. You want to witness the moment our video reaches 500 views.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We all worked very hard on it, so it's only natural to hope that a lot of people watch it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly!
See, Hona gets it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Unfortunately, our break's just about over, so we should get back to practicing–

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
We just got a view! We made it to 500!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, r-really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
Look! 500, right here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's pretty good considering it's our first upload...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Congratulations, girls.
We got to help you shoot it, so this is exciting for us as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so wonderful. All these people have listened to your song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Miku!
But... Here, take a look at this one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The one with you singing already has 1,600 views.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: 1,600? Already?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It just goes to show that lots of people want to hear you sing, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Way to go, Miku-P♪
You're so popular!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: S-Stop it, Rin...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice going, Miku-P.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho?! You too...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's so nice to see them all smiling.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Especially since I was able to do some video editing for it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Unlike the others, I can't write songs or perform well enough to lead our performances... But I want to keep contributing in whatever ways I can.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's get back to practicing.
We don't have much time left until our next show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's do everything we can right now to make sure we resonate with the crowd when we play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!
Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're Leo/need! Thank you all for listening!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The audience responded really well this time, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, they did! Remember how they were so standoffish when we first performed here?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only that, lately more people seem to be making an effort to be at the front.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's true!
Do you think it's because of our videos?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That might be part of it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'm sure some people gained an interest in us after seeing us perform with anemone, and we got more attention after Shibuya Festa, too. I think everything up to this point has made a difference.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
We have done a lot up to this point...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nice to think that all our hard work is actually paying off in the form of people coming to see us perform.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! So...!
Let's keep rocking it like we have been!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, let's!
Once we finish cleaning up, we can start talking about the schedule for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That person... Who is he?
He's looking at us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
Yeah, does he work here? I don't think I've seen him before...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He seems kind of imposing for a new staff member...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, he's coming towards us...

You're Leo/need, right?
Do you all have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How can we help you...?
Oh, excuse me. I should introduce myself first. Here's my card.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Solis Records...?
Yes. I don't expect you to recognize our name since we're a small label...

But I'm the music director there.
My name is Yoshiki Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The music director...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wait, does this mean...?)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I came here today hoping to speak with all of you. So, again, if you don't mind sparing a minute of your time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Speak with us about...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
To get straight to the point...
How would you like to work with us in the future?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Work with...!
I knew it...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've been discovered...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you elaborate on that a little more...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Why don't we move somewhere we can sit down and talk after you've finished cleaning up? I'd rather not keep the staff here waiting.
Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Solis Records...
Oh, I found their website!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The artists signed to them aren't super famous or anything, but I definitely recognize some of these bands...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, that makes them a real record company.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll check with the manager and stuff after just to be sure... But it seems that way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, that means we're...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we need to hear the rest of what he has to say first...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
I apologize about the call. I shouldn't be receiving any more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, that's quite alright...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Haha. Please, try to relax.
All I'm here to do is introduce myself and say a few words. Also, feel free to look into my company as much as you need.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Now that everything you all ordered has arrived, feel free to dig in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, with regards to what I mentioned earlier...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I've actually been following your band for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? A little while...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Ever since you battled against anemone. I believe that was the second time you performed there as a band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I initially went that day to see anemone play...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But your performance was a nice surprise. anemone's a solid band, but you more than stood your ground.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You seemed determined to not let anemone hog all the glory, which led to you turning that live house on its head.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: There are as many bands out there as stars in the sky, but that performance shone a bit brighter than most.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You really seemed to strike a chord with everyone there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (He felt all that after seeing us play...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki and Ichika worked so hard on our song, and we spent so much time practicing it... We put all that effort into that show, so this is wonderful to hear...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: After that, I decided to follow you as a band...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I also listened to the VIRTUAL SINGER song you uploaded to your channel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What...?!
You did?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes.
Lately, quite a few bands have been making their debuts after starting by producing VIRTUAL SINGER songs.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your activity on that front informed my decision to try to speak with all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, so... I'll be following your activities moving forward, and should an opportunity arise, I'd like the chance to work with you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Would you mind letting me know when you do a solo show?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A solo show?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We don't have any plans to do one as of yet...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I see.
I was looking forward to hearing you play more...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
In that case...
Would you consider doing one in the near future?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I suggest that you do one sooner rather than later if you are looking to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A solo show...
I was thinking that we should get a little better first...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, given this opportunity, we'll start thinking about doing one.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Please feel free to ask if you ever feel that you need some help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. We appreciate it.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I thought my heart was gonna jump out of my chest!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too.
I really wasn't expecting to suddenly hear from a record company...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: More importantly, he decided to reach out to us after listening to our songs...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Just focusing on us being high school girls would be pretty lame! Okay, to be fair, that is part of who we are...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It seems that they're not ready to sign us just yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, this is a huge opportunity for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If we find a way to put on a good show, they may really consider signing us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
And then... We'll be pros...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. They're not a major label, so we'd be indie artists...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But signing with a label and making our debut means just that. We'd be professional musicians.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've never done a solo show before, so I'm a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I don't want to let this opportunity slip.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Looks like we all feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Let's do it.
Let's put on a solo show and cut a path towards going pro!

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If our solo show ends up being a success, we may actually be given a chance to become professionals...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That means I... I have to do everything in my power to make that a reality...!)
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, because of that, we've decided to do our next show all by ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That's so cool...!!!
Does that mean you're gonna go pro soon?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Slow down. That's not what they said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you may be given a chance to if your solo show goes well, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, we want it to succeed no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Good luck, girls.
We'll help you in any way we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thanks, Miku!
We'll do our best...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, have you already begun preparing for it...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we have. We're currently in the middle of figuring out what we need to do as we prepare for it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the more we research, the more we realize that putting on a show by ourselves is a considerable amount of work.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm sure.
This is different from battling against other bands.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. In terms of time, we've become accustomed to being given thirty minutes or so to play a set of three or four songs...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, a solo show will need to last an hour at the very least. Even including the time we spend talking between songs, we'll need to have about eight songs ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, we need to book a venue, gather all the equipment we need, make fliers and online accounts for advertising and sell tickets.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That is a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're gonna do our best to both practice and get all those things done!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially since our dream of going pro depends on this, and it'll be our very first solo show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Let's do everything we can to make sure it's a good one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've had a chance to report on everything that's happened, let's put our backs into practicing.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Which song should we start with?
One that still needs work might be preferable.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But for today, I'd like to see how much we can handle.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Remember what Honami just said?
We're gonna need to play like eight songs for our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course, just playing them shouldn't be an issue for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, if I asked you guys to play the way we did with anemone for eight songs, would you be able to?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're right...
I was out of breath after three songs that time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, since you have to sing and play your guitar at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
So, I wanna see how much each of us can handle right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why I'm thinking that we try playing seven songs back to back, excluding our new one... Ideally, we'll be able to play five or so no problem.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(We've never played that many songs in a row before...
I'm a little concerned...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I'll just have to give it my best shot...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (For the sake of our big chance!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's four...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We're finally at the halfway mark, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Ichika is getting winded...
She did sing with just about everything she had...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki's also slowly falling out of rhythm, and my arms are starting to not move the way I tell them to. I'm not sure if we can handle three more songs at the same pace...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, next song...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho, mind if we take a quick break...?
I mean, we'll have time to talk and get a drink of water between songs during the show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami...
My goal for today is to see how much we can handle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If we can't get through our whole set during practice with energy to spare, we're gonna run out of gas when it really counts, even if we do have those small breaks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's okay. I can keep going...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Same... I wanna keep going until the end!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, let's keep going until the end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's continue.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As I suspected, we really fell apart towards the end...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish I had more stamina...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't sing as loud during the second half and was too tired to focus properly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too... I was totally exhausted towards the end...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's incredible how much of a physical and mental toll this takes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, now we know where we're at...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, in order for us to play all the way through, we should practice more moving forward and throw in some strength training to build up our stamina.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm?
Hona, is something wrong? You look kinda concerned.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I was just thinking that I'll have to make adjustments to our schedule if we're going to practice more moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
We'll have to think about how often we can work too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We'll have to set aside time to prepare tickets and get the equipment we need.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Between added practice and all the work we have to do... This schedule might end up tougher than we can imagine. I'll need to figure out a better way than normal for us to get through it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, if I have time to feel worried, I have time to do what needs to be done...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So that we can go pro together...!)
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness we were able to book the live house where Shiho works...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Today, I'll fill out the equipment application form for us to submit next week. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, Honami's already here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, she's right! You're here super early! We even came ahead of schedule too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I was hoping to get some things done before practice... I was actually downstairs before, but they said I could head in a little early.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see.
Oh, are those the forms we need to hand in to the live house...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
I don't help produce our songs or anything, so I thought this was the least I could do for us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Thanks, Honami. We really appreciate it. Also, please ask us if you ever feel that you need help with anything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, but I should be fine now since you and the others have agreed to handle our advertisements on social media.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, Hona, you always seem to come through for us in these sorts of situations! It's like, you're so efficient...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, since you're awful at this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Urgh...! I-I'm not that awful!
I just have to spend a little more time than others thinking about how to do it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't that the definition of not being good at something...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You think so?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It's okay, Saki. With a little practice, I'm sure you'd get used to doing this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona!
Yeah, you're right! It's all about getting used to doing it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, for now I'd rather you focus on getting used to playing eight songs back to back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, let's start practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This also happened yesterday, Ichika, but your voice falls off at our fifth song. Try to hang in there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Groan*
It's so much harder to play during the second half...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I know what you mean...
My arms are starting to feel sore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you have the most physical job out of all of us. Drumming's like a full-body workout!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha. I'm not unathletic or anything, but drumming for this long is a different story...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I need to keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We've improved a little since yesterday, but we're still struggling to play at an acceptable level during the second half...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As important as it is to play like we mean it, we should probably start thinking about how to pace ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is turning into some kind of sport...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's try again after a short break.
Do you all have something to drink? Or shall I go get some?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Honami.
But I brought one, so I'm okay for now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Same here.
So, let's pick this back up in fifteen minutes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
Someone's getting a call.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, it's from work...
Yes, this is Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The form for renting equipment?
One of my bandmates is working on that now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you need it today...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're gonna rent out some equipment for a show at an outdoor venue, so they have to know what we need in advance...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, do you think you can have that form ready by the end of today...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, yes. I had it mostly done this morning, but I still need about another thirty minutes to finish it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
Sorry, we're gonna need you to work on that today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's fine.
I'll work on it now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks...
Then, I'll go hand it in later tonight. See you then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry for making you rush like this. I know we still have to practice...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, is there a way to split the work between us? We'll help out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It really isn't that much work, so it's okay for you all to focus on practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, we'd prefer to practice with you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, Ichi, why don't we work on our new song in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Good idea...
This was meant to be a chance for us to practice together, but we also have other things to take care of...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, I'll draw up the stage diagram that we need to submit. Can I ask you to handle the rest?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Having to do all this paperwork is already affecting our practice...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to wrap this up so we can go back to practicing together...!)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
The company we asked to print out our fliers last time is gone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? Wait, the one we asked for Shibuya Festa? They had such reasonable prices and did a really nice job...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I was hoping that we could ask them again since the quality was good, but we're gonna need to find a different company now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, we need to burn some CDs to sell during our show. I'll ask Tsukasa if I can borrow his computer and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what should we do about the cover art...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm in charge of advertising, so I've been trying to find the best way to do that...

rows.Line: You handled all the paperwork for us and are even taking care of the equipment this time around. We can't ask you to do more...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Plus, if you end up cutting back too much on practice, it'll be all for naught.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because the drummer's the cornerstone of any band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Don't worry about us.
We promise to get our song ready and handle everything else.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Anyway, we'll take it from the top in five minutes... Get ready.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They're right. It's not good for a single band member to carry more than they have to...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is this really the right way to go...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They all want our solo show to go well, and are doing their best to make that happen. But...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It feels like practice isn't going well because we're trying too hard at everything...)

See you tomorrow.

Please be mindful of cars.

Yeah, you're right...

rows.Line:
No, it didn't...
I think preparing for our solo show is taking too much out of us...

rows.Line: Yeah, I had a feeling...

rows.Line: Are we practicing more than we need to...? But we have a new song on the way and don't have much time left...

rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line:
Huh? Oh...

rows.Line:
It's proof that you're working yourself too hard...
I know you're worried about time, but for now, let's get some rest and try again tomorrow.

Thanks, Honami.
See you tomorrow.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Line: (I want us to be able to focus more on practicing, but we can't let all these other things fall by the wayside...)

Class is already over! I must've dozed off...)

rows.Line: Class is adjourned! Thank you very much!

rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Line: (We still have to practice and get ready for our show later, so I should head over to SEKAI now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, maybe I'll ask Ichika and Saki to join me as I head over...)

rows.Line: Ichika? Saki? Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They're not here...
Did I just miss them?
Oh, are you looking for Hoshino and Tenma...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kiritani...!

rows.Line: Hoshino and Tenma may not be back for a while. Some things came up...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing serious.
They both fell asleep during art class is all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They fell asleep?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. They were supposed to finish their drawings today, but couldn't. As a result, they have to stay back to work on them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They seemed very tired...
They were really dozing off during class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Practicing and preparing for our show is a lot for them to handle...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wish I could do something about that, but I don't think there's anything I can...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm...? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um... It's just...
We've been very busy preparing for our solo show, which is probably why they fell asleep today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A solo show?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
We were approached by someone from a record company and they suggested that we do one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really...?! That's great!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you.
However, as happy as we were, the hard work of practicing and preparing for it is starting to take its toll on us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The first one's always the hardest.
Having to do everything yourselves makes it just that much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You and your group did one as well, yes? How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It wasn't easy for us, either.
There was so much we had to do, which was really tough...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it went really well since we were able to become one with our fans...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
Congratulations. That's wonderful to hear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Actually, if possible...
Would you mind telling me how you all prepared for it or what you watched out for on the day of?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know that things can be pretty different between bands and idols... But I was hoping that you might have some tips for me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What we watched out for...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Well...
This is just me talking...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I did my best to not let my mind wander.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Compared to joint shows, you have to think much more carefully about solo shows and do considerably more work, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, it's pretty easy to become overwhelmed by all the things you need to do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, the people who come to see you only have one thing in mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They just want to see an incredible show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I thought only about putting on the best performance possible and making sure our fans have fun. Nothing else.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we did everything we could to make that happen. Including asking others for help when we couldn't handle things on our own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You asked for help...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Some of our supporters decided to lend us a hand in terms of operations and such for the show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Other than that... We ran surveys on stream to ask what people wanted to see and asked acquaintances for suggestions regarding set lists...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I never thought about asking others to help us with things outside of our performance...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I was the same way at first.
In particular, I had reservations about asking our fans to help us directly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, things turned out well in the end...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They were all really happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(What is this I'm feeling...?
I can't quite put it into words...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But Kiritani and her group are so...professional...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They want their fans to genuinely enjoy themselves and get their money and time's worth no matter what...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They're prepared to do everything in their power to make that happen...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (My level of thinking was nowhere near that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I want our solo show to be fun...
But I also kept thinking about succeeding so that we can go pro or trying to reduce everyone's workload.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I failed to prioritize the people who'd actually be coming to see us perform.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(After all, that's our primary goal...
To play music that moves people's hearts and put on fun performances for them...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, there was one other thing on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We want to enjoy our show from the bottom of our hearts, just as much as our fans do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you fall into the trap of thinking “our show has to be fun”, it ends up being pretty dull and the audience will notice right away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, it's important to do something that you yourselves enjoy and are satisfied with. We really tried not to forget that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In summary...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Put on the best performance you can that your audience will enjoy, and have fun yourselves.
That's what we told ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Have fun ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, because you're taking what you do seriously, it's not always going to be smooth sailing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But even so, I believe it's important to remember to keep having fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I now see that I was letting my mind wander far too much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll think more about putting on a solo show that we and our audience will genuinely enjoy...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad I could help.
Good luck with your show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is my new starting line.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is where I'll really and truly begin doing everything I can do!)

*Sob*

Sorry for being late.
Were you waiting for us?

rows.Speaker: Honami

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because I received some wonderful advice while I was at it!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm going to try even harder moving forward! So, you two, let's go practice...!

rows.Line: But I don't think we have time to worry about that now.

rows.Line: Because we've been practicing and preparing for our show at the same time, we've begun exhausting ourselves...

rows.Line: I definitely understand the desire to do everything right for our very first solo show...

rows.Line: What's most important?

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: So, for our solo show, we should strive to do just that and even more.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Line: We need to prioritize practicing and finishing our new song.

rows.Line: Yes. They're self-employed, so I have a feeling that they'll be able to give us some advice regarding our finances and how to negotiate deals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll do all the asking of course, so there's no need to worry. For now, please focus on practicing and finishing our song.

rows.Line: But won't that be asking too much of you, Honami...?

rows.Line: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

rows.Line: I'd like for you all to focus on how to make our show fun for our guests.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know much about what it's like to be in a band, but I understand that putting on a show all by yourselves is no small task...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Our original plan was to do all of these things on our own, but we've been having to cut back on practice to do so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In order for us to put on the best performance we can for our audience, I'd like for them to focus on our music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I know I'm asking a lot of you, but we really need your help...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, putting on a good performance is a team effort.

rows.Line:
The reservation list for tickets.
Despite not having sold any ourselves yet, we already have this many people waiting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This many?!
So, the account you set up and the website Rui put together are really working?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm seeing quite a few newcomers here. That has to be pretty big.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, we still haven't reached our goal... So, let's do our best and sell as many tickets as we can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do it!
This place is gonna be super packed!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.
Okay, break a leg.

rows.Speaker: Band Members
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh...?
That voice...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, it's you guys. What a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Mr. Shindo!
Hello!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Hello.
You're not playing today, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. We just had a meeting regarding our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Ah, that's good to hear.
I saw on your account that you've all been hard at work. I take it things are going well?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, they are. We were honestly pretty overwhelmed at first by everything we had to get done...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we figured out a way and have been able to focus on practicing, so things have improved!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, Mr. Shindo, are you here for work?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes.
I came to see one of our bands play today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You might be familiar with them.
They're called “Gimme!!”. They just debuted as indie artists with our label.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait... That Gimme!!...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know them, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, though just that they mostly play around Yokohama and are pretty popular... I didn't realize they were signed to your company, Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, they signed with us right around the time I met with your band. Today, they'll be playing here for the second time as we try to have them play more and more venues...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Would you like to stay and watch the show?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is that allowed...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes.
They might just become your agency seniors at some point.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They might become our seniors!
Hehe... This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Slow down, Saki.
Let's watch and learn for today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(A band that's already made their debut...
I've had a chance to see STANDOUT play, but I haven't really seen any other professional bands live.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wonder what they're like...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They should be starting soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Wow...!
So much power! It's like their music's sucking me in...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This is who's signed to them...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Their vocalist's voice...
It goes so well with their unique style...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is incredible... It's like only her voice can make the sad parts come to life...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(They're playing at a high level too...
So high that they'd put up a good fight against Iori and her band.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (How long would it take for us to be able to put on this kind of performance...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Such presence...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(This is who they're looking for...
Bands like them are the ones they want to sign...)

rows.Speaker: Vocalist for Gimme!!
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming today, you guys!
And don't forget to join us for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Is something the matter?
None of you look all that excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh... Um, it's just...
They're really good is all.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Ah, yes they are...
And they've become pretty popular.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: By the way... What struck you most about them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll start by mentioning their high skill level. I thought they were very sound technically...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I thought they were very unique...
I liked how their style and the vocalist's voice meshed so well together.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Every professional band has those sorts of weapons in their arsenal.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: For instance, Gimme!! possesses the qualities you just mentioned. They're a technically sound band with a distinctive style.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Do you think your band currently has something that they don't?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. I suppose I went a little too far.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Obviously, I don't think you're bad performers or anything. You in particular are an astounding bassist, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, I'm sorry to say that you'll need more than that to have a chance at success.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And we won't be able to sign bands that we don't believe will become successful. After all, business is business.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, if you're serious about going pro, I'd like for you to all think about how you can become successful and make full use of the weapons that you have.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Make full use...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, you're saying that we already possess those kinds of weapons...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: First, the songs and lyrics you write. Both are well-liked by people your age.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Plus, you're able to produce both songs that revolve around darker themes and happy and fun ones.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In time, you should be able to wield it to great effect. However, you'll need more than just that to really succeed as a band...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, what's our secret weapon...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
There's one more.
Which is...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your youth...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Everyone in Gimme!! is on average about twenty-four years old. You have quite an advantage over them in that department.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our youth...? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you plan on billing us as a band made up of high school girls...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, I'd heard rumors that you preferred not to be billed as one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...!
Then, why did you...?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Like I just said...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You all have potential.
You produce good songs and keep improving as performers.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
However...
It takes a lot to succeed in showbiz.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So you want us to take advantage of our “youth”?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your age may not seem all that important from your point of view.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But it is to the public.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Take sports for instance.
Quite a few people out there prefer to watch high school or college baseball instead of the pros.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Getting to see youngsters do their best and make the most of their adolescence acts as a big hook for them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, why not take advantage of that?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: There are countless bands out there striving to go pro. In order to climb the ladder and survive, you need to have some weapons up your sleeve, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, we don't deny that fact...
But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But that seems wrong, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Wrong? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I... I mean...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You should rid yourself of that kind of pride. If you wish to make your dream come true, you have to make a few sacrifices.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do we do...?
This is all happening way too fast...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We need to make use of whatever we can if we actually want to go pro... I get that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't entirely disagree with what Mr. Shindo is saying...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (He's not wrong, but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is that the right way to go...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can't forget about what's most important to us...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You sound dissatisfied...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I understand how you all feel, but there's nothing wrong with using the weapons you have at your disposal...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: If you need time to think...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we won't.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have a feeling that we'll regret it if we do...
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You'll regret it...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: What makes you think that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand to some degree that succeeding as professional musicians isn't easy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I also understand that using our age to our advantage is one way of doing so...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't want our audience to focus on us “making the most of our youth”.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The four of us want to play music that really moves people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We may be a little different from your average band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We didn't form our band for the sake of forming a band. We formed our band because the four of us are childhood friends who wanted to be together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But since then... Our feelings have evolved quite a bit. As I interacted with the others, I found myself wanting to play music that can touch the hearts of lots of people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Even the songs you complimented us on...
They weren't written with selling records in mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki worked incredibly hard on them because she thought a lot about us and our audience.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That also goes for Ichika's lyrics and how Shiho plays during our shows. Our primary goal is to reach the hearts of as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That may seem unnecessary in terms of becoming professional musicians. But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I want us to stay true to our feelings. No matter what.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Even if it means not being able to go pro...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We still will...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll go pro without letting go of our feelings...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Not only that...
If we try to take advantage of something we shouldn't...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We won't be able to put on performances that we can enjoy and be satisfied with.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If we can't fully commit ourselves, we won't be able to play music that moves people's hearts. We won't reach anyone.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (If they can't fully commit...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We know that going pro means making some sacrifices.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, we want to be the ones who decide what we actually sacrifice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So that we can stay true to our feelings.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree with Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Mr. Shindo...
Yes, we want to go pro, but we won't be satisfied with just that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We want to put on the best performances we can to move the hearts of as many people as we can. That's why we want to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As such, we're not going to let anything shake our beliefs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If it's weapons we need, then we'll find some moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're going to do everything we can to become a band that a label is proud to have...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, please come see our next show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We promise to make it an incredible one!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (Interesting...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Understood...
If you're willing to say that much, it seems like I can expect something very good...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to your solo show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (They're going to decide what sacrifices they make in order to stay true to their feelings, eh...?)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Despite being so young, they've got some sharp tongues.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
(However, life is not so easy...
You need to use whatever weapons are at your disposal to survive in this world.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (Going down that path does involve losing certain things...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (Things that you wish to protect are especially at risk...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
They showed me their resolve today.
It's clear that they have no problem with expressing how they truly feel. So, they should be able to handle a few rough waves.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Still, that Mochizuki girl...
She seemed like the meek and quiet type, but she's actually got some backbone.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that she's going to become the pillar that supports her band. I'll need to keep her in mind when we make our official offer...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (Since bands that don't have someone like her usually end up falling apart...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Hello, Boss? Is now a good time?
Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I have some news regarding a band called Leo/need...
Live House

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (My heart's still racing...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The way I just let out what I was feeling... I still sort of can't believe what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
Now that I can relax, I...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That was so tense...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We were just watching the show, and then somehow ended up having that conversation...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you really came through for us back there, Honami... Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, what happened?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry...!
My legs gave out after I took a sigh of relief...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How do you feel? Can you stand?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Here, grab onto me!
Whoa! Your hand's shaking like crazy...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... I must be realizing now just how scary that was...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I'm really sorry, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A record company reached out to us, but I ended up taking a stand against them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If we end up not receiving an offer from them because of this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Is that what you're worried about...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I just said I agree with you, Honami.
And it's the truth.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were able to stay true to our feelings because you were willing to act.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's right, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was starting to feel like we'd have to make some really ugly choices if we wanted to go pro...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you saved us. Because of what you said, I realize now that we have to protect the thing we care about the most!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for saving us back there, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Girls...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No...
I should be the one thanking you...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright!
Now we've gotta put on the most powerful solo show ever!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The most powerful...
That sounds kinda dumb.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
N-No, it doesn't!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. But we should try to make it our best show yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
So, why don't we have another set of intense training sessions starting tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Another? Like the ones we did when we were preparing to battle against anemone...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I wasn't sure if we could because of everything else we had to do for our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you did a lot for us there, Honami, which means we have a little time on our hands.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right... Yeah!
I bet we'll improve super quickly if we practice hard together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree!
And it'll give us a chance to perfect our new song...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, you in particular haven't been able to practice as much since you've been so busy getting everything ready for our show. So, let us help you get up to speed...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're going all out, so I hope you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm ready...!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Did we just...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We did it... We played the entire set with everything we had!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Woohoo...!!!
We did it! We did it, Hona!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep...! Oh, Saki...
You know it's not safe to throw yourself at me like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I couldn't help myself! I'm just so happy!
Oh, Miku, you guys... How'd we do?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you have to ask? It was a wonderful performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If we can do this, then we should be more than ready for our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But we can't let our guard down.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! It's our very first solo show, so we've gotta make it lots of fun for everyone who comes to see us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
We couldn't have made it this far without you, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I neither write songs for us nor can I lead our performances, so I didn't think I could contribute much.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(But this time...
It feels like I'm actually helping us move forward a little.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've cleared our first hurdle, let's start working on each individual song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ready!
